items.title: Can Africa seize its moment in the race for critical minerals?
items.author: Andy Home
items.creator: Andy Home
items.summary: The intensifying global competition for critical minerals could be a transformative moment for Africa.
items.body:
The intensifying global competition for [USN:L8N3XT0HP TEXT:"critical minerals"] could be a transformative moment for [USN:L4N3Z70I8 TEXT:"Africa"].
The continent is already a major producer of energy transition metals such as copper, cobalt and manganese but is nowhere near its full potential.
Africa's share of global mineral revenues sits at just 10%, despite accounting for 30% of the world's reserves, according to the Brookings Institution .
There may be yet more riches hidden underground. It's difficult to know, because the continent was the target of just 10% of global mineral exploration in 2024, according to the U.S. think-tank Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS).
Moving forward, however, that number is likely to increase as Africa becomes the front line in the global battle for resources, with the West vying with China for control of metals that are core components of both green technologies and AI data centers.
Can Africa seize its metallic moment?
To do so, the continent must break with a long history of resource exploitation by external powers.
European colonisation of Africa in the late 19th and early 20th centuries laid the foundations for unequal trading relationships centred on the extraction of raw materials for overseas markets — a pattern that persists to this day.
From the rubber plantations in the Belgian Congo through goldfields in South Africa to the copper mines of what is now Zambia, Africans have provided the blood, sweat and tears only to see the rewards reaped by foreign owners.
Now, many African governments are realising that the global hunger for critical metals offers a unique chance to change the terms of resource trade.
LET'S BUILD A SMELTER One obvious route African nations can take to capture more value from mining is to build more processing capacity.
Indonesia has shown others the way. The country [USN:L1N43T09Z TEXT:"banned exports of nickel"] ore in 2020, forcing miners to invest in smelters.
The strategy has been so successful that Indonesia is now the world's dominant producer, exporting a wide spectrum of nickel products, including high-purity refined metal and sulphate for battery manufacturers.
African countries have taken note.
Zimbabwe has imposed export controls on [USN:L8N40R0KP TEXT:"lithium"], Guinea on [USN:L8N42R0TW TEXT:"bauxite"] and the Democratic Republic of Congo on both [USN:L8N42V0NT TEXT:"cobalt"] and [USN:L8N4471LS TEXT:"copper"], all with the ambition of leveraging raw materials to expand domestic processing capacity.
However, the number of barriers to establishing a successful processing business [USN:L8N43F1F5 TEXT:"is "vast""], according to a joint analysis by consultancy CRU and the World Bank in a June report .
Power supply, infrastructure, logistics, technical capacity and policy must all be right to make what is a low-margin business profitable even when prices drop.
Indeed, these factors can be more important than the mineral reserves themselves.
Just look at Angola. It is building an aluminium smelter at the port of Barra do Dande despite having neither bauxite nor the capacity to process it into alumina, the intermediate product fed into the smelting process.
What the project does have is a deep-sea port suitable for handling raw materials and a strategic location in a free-trade zone, allowing it to benefit from shared infrastructure, favourable business rates and reliable power supplies.
CORRIDORS OF POWER Angola also sits at the end of one of the largest infrastructure projects in Sub-Saharan Africa — one that has huge implications for the region's push to limit external power on the continent.
The [USN:L8N41D26X TEXT:"Lobito Corridor"] will combine new and existing railway lines to link the central African Copperbelt with the Angolan port of Lobito.
The ambitious project is heavily backed by both the U.S. and Europe.
It has massive strategic significance.
The Lobito Corridor offers a Western shipping alternative to the Chinese-built TAZARA railway line running from Zambia to the Tanzanian port of Dar es Salaam.
TAZARA is the transit route for much of the region's copper and cobalt as they start their long journey to a Chinese port.
Chinese companies own and operate some of the largest copper and cobalt mines in the region, beginning a supply chain that ends in Chinese-made electric vehicles or humble air-conditioner units.
The Lobito Corridor is a direct challenge to that dominance. The project cuts freight time from Congo's mines to the sea from over a month to just one week, helping reduce risk for potential private-sector investment.
China has responded with [USN:L8N3WW1C1 TEXT:"a commitment"] to spend $1.4 billion to revamp TAZARA, which it financed in the 1970s.
Ultimately, the competing rail corridors, one heading west and one east, represent a potential win-win for both Congo and Zambia.
GROWTH CONDUCTORS The Lobito Corridor, however, promises much more than a fast exit route for Africa's metals.
It is intended to be an economic booster in its own right, creating agricultural, metals and technology hubs along its 1,800-kilometre (1,120-mile) route.
Western partners in the project are investing not just in hard infrastructure but also in what the European Union describes as "soft connectivity", meaning trade facilitation, technical and vocational training, and a focus on creating local employment.
The results are already tangible in Angola, where railway infrastructure is simply being upgraded rather than built from scratch, as will be the case for the planned extension into Zambia in 2030. Upgrades create more immediate economic opportunity in the local economy.
Congo's copper and cobalt are now accompanied on their journey to Lobito by Angolan agricultural goods from the country's farming heartland in Huambo province.
Angola exported its first avocados to Europe last November thanks to an EU-funded trade logistics platform and a €50-million investment programme in sustainable agricultural chains.
This holistic approach to the Lobito Corridor offers one way out of Africa's historic resource trap.
Even building processing plants doesn't necessarily spread any wealth through the local economy if they operate as export-oriented fiscal enclaves.
Congo's copper production is now largely in the form of high-purity refined metal, but the country still exports almost all of it to China for conversion into manufactured goods.
That needs to change if Africa is to grab a larger share of its mineral revenues.
HISTORIC MINERS Perhaps the single biggest challenge facing African countries seeking to convert mineral wealth into long-term economic growth is how to deal with their traditional workforce.
It's estimated that around 10 million people are directly involved in artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) in Africa, with many more dependent on it for subsistence.
Africans have been mining for thousands of years, and collective small-scale operations have been the norm for most of that time, particularly in rural areas with low employment prospects.
It's dangerous work, but that doesn't prevent the participation of both women and children. Fatalities are common and the environmental impact can be devastating.
The word "artisanal" implies a degree of free agency, but ASM is often more akin to bonded labour. The ore dug out of the ground is sold to middlemen at a fraction of its true value.
In conflict zones such as Congo's eastern provinces and some Sahel countries, ASM can be outright forced labour at mines controlled by insurgent groups.
Africa's historical miners operate in a dark zone thanks to colonial-era laws declaring all such "native" operations illegal.
The result is the criminalisation of millions of people, lost revenue for states and an ethical dilemma for Western companies, many of which are understandably wary of buying metal that may include ASM ore.
There are multiple efforts to "formalise" ASM by integrating the workforce into the official mining sector.
The most ambitious is in Congo, which has long been [USN:L8N3X10GG TEXT:"targeted"] by campaigners for its "blood" cobalt.
Kinshasa has [USN:L8N2N02HM TEXT:"tried"] and failed before to find ways of merging its "illegal" miners into the official sector.
But new cobalt export quota controls and enhanced powers for the mining regulator, the Entreprise Générale du Cobalt, promise better results from a new scheme launched with Eurasian Resources Group.
The irony is that if the West wants Congo's cobalt and doesn't want to rely on Chinese operators, it needs to source from the ASM sector. But the metal has to come with guarantees that it's untarnished by human rights abuses.
It's in everyone's interests to bring Africa's original miners in from the cold. Indeed, for Africa itself, it may be the single most important lever it can pull in terms of changing a blood-soaked historical narrative of exploitation.
(The opinions expressed here are those of Andy Home, a columnist for Reuters.)

Sept 10 : Republican lawmakers plan to bring legislation to the House floor next week that seeks to rein in electricity bill increases tied to data center expansion, a spokesperson for Speaker Mike Johnson said on Thursday.
The plan to hold a vote on the bipartisan Ratepayer Protection Act before the midterm elections was first reported by Axios.
"The bill will be on the floor of the House next week," Taylor Haulsee, a spokesperson for Johnson, said in an email.
Government officials nationwide are under pressure to take steps to prevent the soaring cost of data center power needs from being passed on to average households.

items.title: 米財務長官､予想下回る国債買い戻し巡る懸念一蹴-市場は「良好」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は10日、財務省がこの日実施した長期国債買い戻しの購入額が予想を下回ったことについて懸念を一蹴し、長期国債利回り上昇を巡る不安も重要視しない姿勢を示した。

ベッセント氏は、トランプ大統領の元側近で、政権１期目で大統領首席戦略官を務めたスティーブ・バノン氏とのインタビューで、米国債市場が「非常に良好な状態」にあるとの認識を示し、最近2回の入札が好調だった点を強調した。米国債とエネルギー価格に通常とは異なる高い相関が見られる最近の状況にもあらためて言及した。

財務長官は、2年国債利回りが2024年以来、10年国債利回りが23年以来の高水準に達した後に発言したもので、「ブルームバーグ端末を使っている人々の一部が私のやっていることに不満なら、それは残念だ」とも述べた。

原油相場の高騰に加え、長期国債買い戻しの購入額が予想を下回ったことで売り圧力が高まった。米財務省は9日に最大60億ドル（約9260億円）相当を買い戻すと発表したが、10日の買い入れ額は51億9000万ドルにとどまった。

ベッセント氏は「われわれは安い場合だけ国債を買い戻す」と述べ、今回のケースでは、債券保有者は長期国債を手放したくないようだったと指摘した。「通常は200億ドル相当の売りオファーがある」が、今回は100億ドル程度にとどまったという。

ベッセント氏は過去数週間、利回り低下を後押しする狙いと受け止められている異例の措置を講じている。買い戻しプログラムの拡大や、円を巡る異例の協調介入などが含まれる。

ベッセント氏は10日、イランの動きも一因として、措置を講じていると発言。「選挙を前にしているからやっているのではない」とし、イランが「債券利回り」や原油価格を利用して「米国に経済的な問題を引き起こそうとしている」と指摘した。

また、市場に関する自身の発信を巡り最近繰り返している「今や私が胴元だ」との主張について、ベッセント氏は真意の説明に努めた。

items.title: 円は対ドルで154円台半ば、原油と米金利上昇でドル買い－債券下落へ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 11日の外国為替市場で円は対ドルで154円台半ばに下落。原油価格と米長期金利の上昇を受けてドル買いが優勢になっている。債券はインフレ懸念の高まりにより下落（利回りは上昇）する見込み。

中東情勢の緊迫化で原油の供給懸念が強まり、北海ブレント原油は10日、1バレル＝109ドルを突破した。米国では生産者物価指数（PPI）が大幅に上昇したこともあり、30年債利回りは2007年以来の高水準に上昇。2年債利回りは24年以来初めて4.5%を上回った。

三菱UFJ信託銀行ニューヨーク支店資金証券室のファーストバイスプレジデント、小野寺孝文氏は「インフレ懸念の高まりにより米長期金利が上昇し、ドルが買われた」と語る。ただ、日本銀行の利上げペース加速への思惑から「投機筋もこれまでのように円売り一辺倒ではなくなっており、155円は突破できなかった」と言う。

次の注目は11日発表の消費者物価指数（CPI）。小野寺氏は「予想を上振れれば9月の米利上げ観測が一段と高まり、ドルは155円を突破する可能性がある」とみる。

野村証券の後藤祐二朗チーフ為替ストラテジストは11日のリポートで、イランが支援するイエメンのフーシ派による船舶の紅海航行への影響拡大が警戒される中、「イラン戦争の長期化懸念が原油高と円安圧力を強める可能性に留意したい」としている。

債券は下落する見込み。米長期金利が大幅に上昇したことを受けて売りが先行する。

東海東京証券の佐野一彦チーフストラテジストは「米長期金利が5%を視野に入れる水準まで上昇しており、日本国債にも重しになる」と語る。ただ、超長期債には「一時払い終身保険の販売が好調な生命保険会社が買いを入れているように見え、押し目買いで下げ止まる可能性もある」と言う。

先物の夜間取引で中心限月12月物は10日の日中取引終値比34銭安の125円36銭で終えた。佐野氏の先物の予想レンジは125円19銭－125円49銭、新発10年債利回りは2.935－2.96%（10日は2.91%で終了）。10日の米10年国債利回りは前日比12ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）高い4.96%程度。

items.body:
Trump Promises $5,000 'Dividend' for Americans if Republicans Win Midterms President Donald Trump promises a $5,000 'Trump dividend' for every adult citizen if Republicans succeed in the midterm elections, leveraging tariffs and new investments. He critiques Democrats for proposed tax hikes and underscores achievements in lowering taxes and boosting the military. His rhetoric criticizes the Biden administration's economic policies.
Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 11-09-2026 11:01 IST | Created: 11-09-2026 11:01 IST

US President Donald Trump speaks at the 2026 Republican Convention (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

President Donald Trump announced plans to distribute a $5,000 'Trump dividend' to every adult if Republicans win the upcoming midterm elections. This pledge comes with a claim of trillions in new investments through tariffs. The funds would support permanent tax cuts, reversing potential Democratic tax hikes.
During a speech at the Republican Party’s midterm convention in Dallas, Trump criticized Democrats, accusing them of seeking major tax increases. He asserted his administration's success in fulfilling promises within 19 months and addressed concerns over inflation under President Joe Biden's administration.
Trump portrayed his presidency as a turning point, citing significant tax and regulation cuts, military investments, and positioning America as a global superpower. He positioned these achievements against what he described as the deterioration under the current administration, condemning urban crime and economic issues.

items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米社債の信用リスクを示す主要指標が6週間ぶりの大幅な悪化となった。インフレ統計を受け、米連邦準備理事会（FRB）が来週利上げするとの観測が強まり、社債の買い手が様子見に転じた。

信用不安が高まると上昇するCDX北米投資適格指数のスプレッドは、10日の取引で約1.3ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）拡大し52bpとなった。1日の拡大幅としては7月29日以来の大きさ。リスクが高まると低下するジャンク債のCDX北米ハイイールド指数は約0.32ポイント低下し107.32となった。

10日発表された8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）では、エネルギー価格の上昇に伴いインフレ圧力が再び高まっていることが示され、来週の利上げを後押しする材料となった。金利スワップ市場ではこの日、米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）次回会合の利上げ確率が約70%となった。

ベッセント米財務長官が買い戻し規模の増額を発表して以降、初めて行われたオペで、米財務省による長期債の購入額が市場予想を下回ると、利回りはさらに上昇した。

RBCグローバル・アセット・マネジメントでブルーベイ米債券部門を率いるアンドレイ・スキバ氏によると、運用担当者は米景気が底堅いことを踏まえ、企業の財務や業績見通しよりも金利変動への警戒を強めている。

スキバ氏は「金利の変動が大きくなれば、スプレッドも拡大するとみるべきだ」と述べた。「これは自然な流れとも言える。最近は金利動向に敏感な買い手が投資適格社債を強く支えてきたが、金利市場の値動きが激しくなると、通常は買いをいったん見合わせる」とした。

原油高も社債には逆風だ。10日には原油価格が急騰し、北海ブレント原油先物は1バレル=107ドルを上回った。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）先物も、5月以来初めて102ドル超で引けた。原油高は企業利益の重しとなりかねない。

FAST

Sept 10 : Microsoft plans to build out its data-center capacity to about 38 gigawatts by 2032, more than triple its current footprint, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Here are some details:
• According to the report only about 2 gigawatts of the company's current 12-gigawatt capacity is centered on AI-specific chips, a share expected to grow to about a third of the 38 gigawatts it plans to have online.
• Microsoft did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

• Technology companies have been pouring billions of dollars into data centers to power generative AI services such as ChatGPT and Copilot, which require huge amounts of computing power.
• In July, Microsoft forecast stronger-than-expected cloud growth offering fresh evidence that Microsoft's massive AI investments are beginning to pay off, helping ease investor concerns that heavy spending on data centers and computing infrastructure could outpace demand.
• Microsoft expects capital expenditures of $50 billion for the fiscal first quarter of 2027 and $175 billion for the 2026 calendar year.
• The company is planning to spread long-term leases on data centers over 25 years rather than 15, which has the effect of lowering its annual reported capital expenditures.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Sept 10 : The Pentagon is in talks to lend about $5 billion to AI cloud-computing startup Fluidstack to shore up the U.S. data center supply chain, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The money would come from the Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital, the newspaper said.
Fluidstack would use the loan to shore up the U.S. supply chain and manufacturing capacity for certain data center-related components, rather than funding a new AI facility outright, WSJ added.
The U.S. Department of Defense and Fluidstack did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The Office of Strategic Capital has struck previous deals with rare earth companies Vulcan Elements, Phoenix Tailings and Energy Fuels.
It has also struck deals to provide funding to some drone companies, including Unusual Machines and Sequoia Capital-backed Neros, the WSJ previously reported.

FAST

WASHINGTON: The US government announced new sanctions on Thursday (Sep 10) against firms and individuals that it says are aiding Hezbollah and other Iranian proxies in the Middle East as it intensified its campaign to isolate Iran economically.
The latest sanctions are part of the Treasury Department's "Operation Economic Outcast," first announced Aug 24, which aim to cut off the revenues that Tehran is using to fund the war, build missiles, conduct cyberattacks and support the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, or IRGC.
Thursday's actions by Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control hit entities and individuals in Iraq, Lebanon and Turkey that Washington said supported Kata’ib Hezbollah, an Iraqi Shia paramilitary group under the command of the IRGC, and Hezbollah, a Lebanese Shia party, Treasury said in a statement.
Treasury also announced a settlement with a US citizen who agreed to pay US$1.43 million to settle their potential civil liability for 39 apparent violations of sanctions on Iran, and issued a broad whistleblower appeal for tips on any sanctions evasion or money laundering by Iran.

Related:

Trump says Iran war to end after US midterm elections, threatens to attack Pickaxe Mountain

US slaps sanctions on Iran airlines, service providers

OFAC also issued a bulletin making clear that it would deny most Iran-related licensing requests, except in exceptional circumstances, and said its licensing division had immediately begun denying "the vast majority" of outstanding Iran-related specific license requests.
"OFAC will maintain this licensing policy until Iran changes its behavior, including obstructing the Strait of Hormuz, attacking US personnel and partners in the Gulf, and pursuing nuclear and conventional weapons," Treasury said.
“Operation Economic Outcast is targeting those who continue to stand with the failing Iranian regime,” Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement. “Whether they finance terror, launder money, or help Iran evade sanctions, we will find them, cut them off from the U.S. financial system, and dismantle the networks keeping the regime afloat.”

Source: Reuters/fs

（ブルームバーグ）： 10日の米金融市場では、国債利回りが数年ぶりの高水準を付けた。原油価格の急騰を受け、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が早ければ来週にも利上げを実施するとの見方が強まる一方、利回り上昇を背景に30年債入札には旺盛な需要が集まった。

国債利回りは全年限で7－15ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇。30年債利回りは2007年以来の高水準に達し、2年債利回りは2024年以来の高水準となる4.58％に達した。短期金融市場では来週の利上げ確率が約70%に上昇し、利上げを完全に織り込む時期は従来の12月から10月に前倒しされた。

30年債入札（規模220億ドル）には旺盛な需要が集まり、過去の入札と比べても好調な結果となった。最高落札利回りは5.308%と、入札前取引での利回りを約3bp下回った。投資家の需要が非常に強く、プライマリーディーラーの落札比率は過去最低の2.2%となった。

BMOキャピタル・マーケッツのストラテジスト、ヴェイル・ハートマン氏は「押し目買いに動くには十分割安な水準になった」と指摘。「債券相場に下落圧力がかかる中でも、デュレーションに対する投資家の需要が根強いことを反映している」と述べた。

ただ、入札による相場の押し上げ効果は長続きしなかった。その後に実施された米財務省の長期債の買い戻しでは、購入額が事前に示されていた上限の60億ドルに届かなかったことを受け、国債売りが強まった。

米10年債利回りは一時11bp上昇して4.95%と、2023年10月以来の高水準を付けた。国債利回り上昇の主因は原油価格の急伸だ。米国とイランの戦争が長期化する兆しを受け、北海ブレント先物は前日比6.42ドル（6.3%）高の107.63ドルで終了。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）先物は同6.43ドル（6.7%）高い102.48ドルで引けた。

ミシュラー・ファイナンシャル・グループの金利セールス・トレーディング担当マネジングディレクター、トニー・ファレン氏は「原油価格の上昇はインフレを押し上げる。いったん経済全体に波及し始めれば、抑えるのは難しくなる」と指摘。「インフレが高止まりする限り、利回りの低下は望めない」と述べた。

items.summary: Ukraine secures C$350 million from Canada for critical air defence interceptors as Kyiv runs low on Patriot missiles during intensified Russian attacks.

Canada agrees on C$350 million air defense package for Ukraine, Carney says

Ukraine secures C$350 million from Canada for critical air defence interceptors as Kyiv runs low on Patriot missiles during intensified Russian attacks.

Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney holds a bilateral meeting with Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during his visit to Calgary, Alberta, Canada, on Sep 10, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Todd Korol/Pool)

CALGARY, Alberta: Canada has agreed a C$350 million (US$253 million) aid package for Kyiv to acquire air defense interceptors, Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday (Sep 10) after meeting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Kyiv is running critically low on US-made Patriot interceptors capable of stopping Russia's ballistic missiles at a time when Moscow is stepping up its attacks .
"As Russia escalates its barbaric aerial warfare indiscriminately targeting civilian populations, Ukraine 's air defences are critical," Carney told reporters in Calgary.
"Earlier today Canada and Ukraine finalised an agreement to deliver critical air defence interceptors...this C$350 million equipment package will help protect Ukraine 's people, infrastructure, and skies," he said.

He did not give details of which interceptors would be delivered or when the aid would start flowing.
The weapons will be provided through a US program that allows third-party nations to quickly buy and supply weapons such as Patriot missiles to Ukraine .

Related:

Russia-Ukraine talks possible this month, Zelenskyy says, as Moscow pounds Kyiv

Trump told Putin he wants swift end to Ukraine war and US-Russia ties restored, Kremlin says

"I thank you for this package. It's of (the) utmost importance, especially now," said Zelenskyy.
Canada , one of Ukraine 's most vocal defenders, has committed more than C$25.5 billion in overall aid since Russia invaded in February 2022, including C$8.5 billion in military assistance.
Carney also said Canada aimed to ramp up drone production to be able to produce millions of units within the next two years. A third of those would go to Ukraine , he said.
Zelenskyy said Ukraine needed more technology and funding to produce enough drones to fend off mass Russian attacks.
Canada is home to an estimated 1.3 to 1.4 million people of Ukrainian descent, forming one of the largest Ukrainian diasporas in the world.
As part of the deals signed on Thursday, Canada will provide nearly C$435 million in new loan guarantees to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development to support energy security in Ukraine , especially during the winter.
 
 

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: オラクル、クラウド売上高が市場予想上回る－AI需要が追い風
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米オラクルが10日発表したクラウドコンピューティング事業の成長率はアナリスト予想を上回った。大規模なAI向けデータセンタープロジェクトへの積極投資が成果を上げていることを示した。

発表資料によると、市場が注目するクラウドインフラ事業の売上高は6－8月（第1四半期）に121%増の74億ドル（約1兆1400億円）となった。ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、アナリスト予想平均は71億9000万ドルだった。

同社はまた、時価で随時200億ドル相当の株式を売却する計画を完了したと明らかにした。10日の決算発表を前に、複数のアナリストが市場価格による株式売却のタイミングについて疑問を呈していた。

データベースソフトウエアで長年知られてきたオラクルは、AI処理向けのコンピューティング能力を提供する企業へと事業を転換し、OpenAIなどの顧客向けにデータセンターの大規模な増設に乗り出している。ウォール街は、こうした野心的なプロジェクトへの支出規模と完成スピードを注視している。同社によると、6－8月期にデータセンター容量を850メガワット増強した。

株価はニューヨーク市場の時間外取引で約6%上昇した。通常取引終値は152.94ドル。

6－8月期の設備投資は285億ドルで、大半をデータセンター設備が占めた。ヒラリー・マクソン最高財務責任者（CFO）は記者向け説明会で、2027年5月通期について設備投資を700億ドルとする同社の見通しを確認した。一部部品の前払いに伴い、これとは別に200億－250億ドルを支出する。

同社は6－8月期にAIクラウド契約を新たに300億ドル余り獲得し、将来の売上高の指標となる残存履行義務を積み増した。

6－8月期の売上高は30%増の193億ドル。一部項目を除く1株利益は1.92ドルだった。ブルームバーグの集計データによると、アナリスト予想平均は1.75ドルだった。

items.title: アドビ売上高見通し、市場予想下回る－AI競争への懸念根強く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ソフトウエア大手アドビが示した売上高見通しが、市場予想を若干下回った。AI新興企業からの圧力を巡る懸念を払拭できなかった。

10日の発表資料によると、9－11月（第4四半期）の売上高は68億－68億5000万ドル（約1兆500億－1兆600億円）になる見通しだ。レンジ中央値はブルームバーグがまとめた市場予想の平均68億5000万ドルを下回った。

一部項目を除く1株利益は6.30－6.35ドルを見込む。市場予想平均は6.30ドルだった。

アドビの株価は時間外取引で1%未満の下落となった。年初来では決算発表前の時点で29%下落していた。

AIの影響を巡り、アドビは投資家の信頼が揺らぐ状況に直面している。「Photoshop」などアドビのソフトウエアは長年にわたり、クリエーティブ分野やマーケティング分野の専門家にとって業界標準とされてきた。だが生成AIの普及で、アドビの高価なソフトウエアを使わなくても画像などを容易に制作できるようになった。人気の高い新たなAIツールの多くも競合他社が開発している。

アドビは先週、社内の事業部門トップの一つであるアニル・チャクラバルティ氏を次期最高経営責任者（CEO）に指名した。12月1日付で就任する見通しだ。チャクラバルティ氏が率いていたマーケティング・分析ソフトウエア部門の規模は、主力のクリエーティブ部門を大きく下回るだけに、この人事は一部の投資家にとって予想外だった。CEOのもう1人の有力候補で、クリエーティブ事業を統括していたデービッド・ワドワニ氏は月内に退社する。

調査会社Eマーケターのアナリスト、グレース・ハーモン氏はリポートで「第4四半期の弱い見通しを受け、AIによってクリエーティブソフトウエア市場が変化するなかでアドビが今後どう競争していくのか、そして新CEOがどのような戦略を取るのかという疑問が強まっている」と指摘した。

items.title: 米国債利回り上昇、数年ぶり高水準に－原油高や買い戻しオペ結果響く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 10日の米国債市場では、売りが加速した。原油相場の急伸でインフレ懸念が強まったほか、米財務省が規模増額の発表後初めて実施した国債買い戻しで、購入額が市場予想を下回った。

米国債相場の下落は取引序盤から始まり、2年債は2025年4月の市場急落以来、最大の利回り上昇となった。中東情勢の混乱が激化して原油相場が4カ月ぶりの高値に上昇したほか、8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）統計がインフレ圧力の高まりを示したことが背景にある。

相場の動きには、ベッセント米財務長官による異例の市場介入への疑念も拍車をかけた。ベッセント氏の措置は市場を安定させ、経済全体の借り入れコストを押し上げている長期金利の上昇を抑えることを狙ったものだ。

こうした疑念は9日、拡大を発表した買い戻しの規模がトレーダーの期待に届かなかったことで強まり、10日の購入額が事前に示していた上限の60億ドル（約9260億円）には届かなかったことで一段と膨らんだ。財務省による残存10－20年の国債買い戻しは51億9000万ドルにとどまった。

今回の買い戻しは、過去6カ月にわたって続く米国債売りを和らげるトランプ政権の能力に対する懐疑的な見方を強めた。イランとの戦争が終結する兆しがなく、政府の財政赤字を抑制する計画もない中、投資家はベッセント氏の措置による効果は限定的にとどまる公算が大きいとみている。

DWSアメリカズの債券部門責任者、ジョージ・カトランボーン氏は「ベッセント氏は銃撃戦に水鉄砲で挑んでいるようなものだ」と指摘。「現在の連邦債務残高、財政赤字、インフレを巡る懸念を踏まえると、投資家が米30年債を買うために求める上乗せ金利を抑えるには不十分だ」と論じた。

利回り上昇を主導したのは、米連邦準備制度の金融政策変更の影響を受けやすい短期債だった。トレーダーは、米金融当局が来週にも利上げする可能性を織り込む動きを強めている。

items.body: 03:49 PM EDT, 09/10/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Healthcare stocks declined late Thursday afternoon, with the NYSE Healthcare Index shedding 0.3% and the State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLV) down 0.5%. The iShares Biotechnology ETF (IBB) dropped 1.4%. In corporate news, Cooper (COO) shares fell past 13% after the company cut its fiscal 2026 guidance. Separately, BofA Securities downgraded Cooper to neutral from buy and lowered its price target to $65 from $80. BofA said Cooper could not sell CooperSurgical at an attractive valuation given competition from the Paragard intrauterine device and the fertility litigation settlement. Novartis (NVS) shareholder Artisan Partners called for changes to the Swiss drugmaker's board following two consecutive drug trial setbacks that sent shares tumbling, Reuters reported, citing an interview with Artisan managing director David Samra. Novartis shares were up 0.3%. Orchestra BioMed (OBIO) shares rose past 7% after BTIG upgraded the stock the stock to buy from neutral, with a price target of $10. BioCryst Pharmaceuticals' (BCRX) Ordaleyo faces competitive pressure in the hereditary angioedema treatment space, and its shares are expected to settle within an in-line trading range in the near term, RBC Capital Markets said in a note. RBC downgraded the company's stock rating to sector-perform from outperform and reduced the price target to $11 from $13. BioCryst shares fell 6%.

items.title: Five killed in bus crash near Swiss Alpine village
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Five people were killed and 40 others injured after a bus carrying a Dutch tour party flipped over in a remote Alpine region of eastern Switzerland, police said on Thursday.
items.body:
Five people were killed and 40 others injured after a bus carrying a Dutch tour party flipped over in a remote Alpine region of eastern Switzerland, police said on Thursday.
Police in the canton of Grisons said the accident occurred near the village of Susch, and images of the scene published online showed the vehicle lying on its side next to the road, surrounded by police and emergency service personnel.
Three of those hurt were in a serious condition, seven had moderately serious injuries, and 30 were slightly injured, police said, noting there were 45 adults on the bus.
The dead, who were all adults, have yet to be identified.
A spokeswoman for the General Dutch Association of Travel Companies, acting as spokesperson for tour operator OAD, said a serious accident had taken place involving an OAD bus and that 48 passengers were on board, all Dutch nationals.

items.title: Is Trump's $5,000 'dividend' legal and how would it work?
items.author: Andy Sullivan, Jonathan Stempel, Saqib Ahmed
items.creator: Andy Sullivan, Jonathan Stempel, Saqib Ahmed
items.summary: President Donald Trump on Wednesday proposed a $5,000 Trump dividend payment to U.S. adults if his Republicans retain control of the House of Representatives and the Senate in the November 3 midterm elections.
items.body:
President Donald Trump on Wednesday proposed a [USN:L1N45203G TEXT:"$5,000 "Trump dividend" payment"] to U.S. adults if his Republicans retain control of the House of Representatives and the Senate in the November 3 midterm elections .
Here is what we know about Trump's pledge:
WHO WOULD GET THE MONEY AND WHERE WOULD IT COME FROM? Trump said the checks would go to all adult U.S. citizens -- about 240 million people, according to the U.S. Census. That would cost a total of $1.2 trillion.
Vice President JD Vance suggested on Fox News after Trump's speech that the U.S. government could draw on tariff revenue, which has been juiced by Trump's trade wars . The Congressional Budget Office estimates the government has taken in $167 billion so far in the fiscal year that ends September 30 -- not nearly enough to cover the cost of Trump's proposed giveaway.
Trump's $5,000 dividend plan draws some Republican skepticism
The payments would instead widen the government's budget gap, which is already at a level that [USN:S0N43F052 TEXT:"alarms budget watchdogs"].
CBO estimates the government will spend $2.1 trillion more than it collects in revenue in the current fiscal year and projects that figure will grow in the years to come as the population ages.
WOULD THE PAYMENTS BE LEGAL? Candidates regularly promise benefits in return for votes.
During the 2024 presidential campaign, Trump promised tax breaks for seniors, tipped workers and other targeted groups —and delivered them in his "One Big Beautiful Bill" the following year.
Democratic candidates, including President-elect Joe Biden, promised a third round of COVID-19 relief checks in a Georgia special election in 2021 and delivered when they won control of Congress.
The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that a comparable promise is legal. In a unanimous 1982 decision, the high court overturned a lower-court ruling that had invalidated the election of a Kentucky official who had promised to save taxpayer money by lowering county commissioners' salaries.
Elon Musk, the world's richest person, [USN:L6N42X16V TEXT:"offered voters a chance to win $1 million"] in 2024 if they signed a petition to support the Constitution. That drew legal challenges, still unresolved, from voters who said they had no real chance to win because Musk was seeking people to support his political action committee, which backed Republican candidates.
It would be difficult to challenge Trump's dividend in court, as voters might have trouble showing that they had been directly harmed.
WOULD THIS HAVE TO PASS CONGRESS? Yes. Congress has authority over spending under the U.S. Constitution.
Trump's Republicans control both the House and the Senate by narrow margins, and several members of his party have already reacted favorably to the idea.
Democrats would be sure to oppose any legislation and could block passage in the Senate, where a supermajority of 60 votes is needed to advance most legislation.
Republicans could invoke a complex budget process to bypass Democrats and approve the bill along party lines. They have successfully used this approach twice since Trump's January 2025 return to office, but have struggled to advance a third such package.
They have little time to act before the November 3 elections, as the House is scheduled to be in session for only one week before then. Congress could also try to act in a "lame-duck" session after the election.
HAS THE U.S. GOVERNMENT GIVEN MONEY DIRECTLY TO CITIZENS BEFORE? Yes. Congress approved three separate direct payments in March 2020, December 2020 and March 2021 as part of sweeping relief packages to help people weather the economic disruption from the COVID-19 pandemic. Those payments — up to $1,200, $600 and $1,400 per adult, respectively — were phased out for higher-income people. That amounted to 476 million payments totaling $814 billion, according to a congressional oversight committee. Investigators found numerous logistical problems, including fraud and $1.4 billion sent to dead people.
HOW WOULD THIS AFFECT THE ECONOMY AND FINANCIAL MARKETS? Economic studies have shown that the pandemic-era stimulus checks contributed to the subsequent rise in inflation by substantially boosting consumer demand.
Those payments also boosted the stock market, with a measurable spike in retail trading volumes following each wave of stimulus deposits.
But Trump's proposed dividend could upend bond markets if the government funded it through borrowing. The massive influx of new Treasury debt, combined with revived inflation fears, could drive bond prices sharply lower and send yields soaring.
That could push government borrowing costs higher, further pressuring the U.S. budget at a time when interest payments already exceed military spending.
Yields on [USN:L4N4520VC TEXT:"benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury bonds"] ticked up to 4.91% on Thursday as investors assessed Trump's proposal.
HAS TRUMP MADE SIMILAR PROMISES IN THE PAST? Trump promised a similar $2,000 dividend in November 2025 tied to tariff revenue and said it would not apply to wealthy people, though no follow-up action was taken.
Trump successfully sent a one-time "warrior dividend" payment of $1,776 to roughly 1.45 million military members in December 2025, drawing on money already approved by Congress.
On Thursday, Trump's White House said nearly 1 million Americans will get [USN:FWN4520NI TEXT:"$500 payments"] to account for what it describes as excess fees charged for Affordable Care Act health insurance.

items.title: 【欧州市況】短期債売られる、ECBの利上げ観測が拡大－株は3日続落
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 10日の欧州債券市場は、短期債が下落した。欧州中央銀行（ECB）が利上げを決定し、インフレ見通しを引き上げたことを受け、追加利上げ観測が拡大した。英国でも、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）による追加利上げが織り込まれ、国債は大幅下落した。

ドイツ2年国債利回りは一時13ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して3.20%と、2023年10月以来の水準を付けた。10年債利回りは6bp高い3.51%と、2009年以来の高水準となった。

短期金融市場は現在、ECBが来年6月までに25bpの利上げをさらに3回行うと、完全に織り込んでいる。

英国債も売られた。2年債利回りは17bp上昇して4.87%と、約3年ぶりの高水準に達した。

欧州株は3日続落した。原油価格の急騰やECBの新たな経済予測を受け、インフレへの懸念が強まった。

ストックス欧州600指数は0.7%下落し、7月以来の安値で取引を終えた。銅価格の下落を背景に鉱業株が最も大きく下げた。一方、北海ブレント原油が1バレル＝105ドルを突破したことを受け、エネルギー株は相対的に堅調だった。フランスのCAC40指数は0.5%下落し、年初からの上昇分を失った。

原題：Europe Bonds Drop as ECB Rate Hike Bets Jump: End-of-Day Curves、European Stocks Decline on Inflation Worries After ECB, US Data（抜粋）

items.title: 中国問題の緊急性増す欧州、強硬策を協議－報復回避もなお模索
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ドイツ人技術者のゼンケ・ジークフリートセン氏は、浮体式洋上風力発電タービンの画期的な設計をあみ出し、4月にはスペインのサンチェス首相にその設計を提案した。しかし、このエピソードにはもどかしさも残る。

この設計の考案に、ジークフリートセン氏は7年を費やした。ところが、この設計を基にした革新的な2基のローターを備えた浮体式プラットフォームをサンチェス氏に紹介したのは、同氏から1基当たりのライセンス契約で特許を買い取った中国の再生可能エネルギー機器メーカー、明陽智慧能源集団だった。

何よりつらかったのは、ジークフリートセン氏自身の会社が欧州で提携先を見つけられず、3カ月前に事業を停止していたことだ。

ジークフリートセン氏はインタビューで、「中国の実業家は、私の設計の助けを借りて事業を成功させることができた」と述べた。

この件は欧州企業が中国の競合に、競争力や戦略、資金力でますます後れを取っていることを示す数多くの事例の一つに過ぎない。

欧州でこうした不満が出るのは今に始まったことではない。太陽光発電でも、そうだった。中国は欧州から設備を輸入してノウハウを蓄積・習得し、大規模な生産で欧州の競合企業を圧倒した。

だが、この問題は欧州連合（EU）各国の首脳にとって、緊急性を増している。10月にブリュッセルで開かれる首脳会議では、新たな関税措置や輸出規制、投資審査を組み合わせで中国への対応を打ち出すことを目指している。

ブルームバーグ・エコノミクス（BE）の新たな分析によると、ここ数年で中国メーカーに市場シェアを奪われたことによるEU27カ国の経済的な影響は、2025年に域内総生産（GDP）の0.7%、金額にして約1500億ドル（約23兆1000億円）に達した。前年の推計ではGDP比0.5%だった。

BEの貿易担当エコノミストで、マエバ・クザン氏とともにリポートを執筆したニコール・ゴートンカラテッリ氏は、「先端製造業で中国は急速にシェアを拡大している」と指摘した。

items.title: Fake Fox News graphic says Trump ordered death penalty for Lindsay Clancy
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: A fabricated Fox News graphic was shared online to claim that U.S. President Donald Trump has imposed the death penalty on Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose trial for killing her three young children ended in a mistrial on September 4.
items.body:
A fabricated Fox News graphic was shared online to claim that U.S. President Donald Trump has imposed the death penalty on Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose trial for killing her three young children [USN:L1N44V0ZD TEXT:"ended in a mistrial"] on September 4.
Here are the key details:
Clancy’s attorneys argued that she was not guilty by reason of insanity because the tragedy occurred while she was suffering from postpartum psychosis.
A September 3 X post shared the fabricated graphic featuring Fox News’ logo with the text: “President Trump Issues Executive Order To Throw Down the Death Penalty On Lindsay Clancy.”
However, a spokesperson for the outlet told Reuters that it was not an authentic Fox News graphic.
There are no credible reports of such an order from Trump, who has said publicly that he had been following the trial and that Clancy’s [USN:L1N4500KR TEXT:"lawyer had asked"] Trump to pardon her, even though the case was prosecuted under state law.
Massachusetts law does not authorize capital punishment under its current murder statute.
A White House spokesperson said by email, "this is obviously fake."
Trump signed an executive order on January 20, 2025, directing the U.S. Department of Justice to pursue the federal death penalty in eligible federal cases. He has not imposed the order on a specific defendant in any case.
Verdict: False. The image does not show an authentic Fox News graphic and there are no credible reports of Trump imposing or calling for the death penalty for Lindsay Clancy.
This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

items.title: Iranian arms and advice helped Yemen's Houthis seize key Red Sea city, sources say
items.author: Parisa Hafezi, Mohammed Ghobari, Timour Azhari
items.creator: Parisa Hafezi, Mohammed Ghobari, Timour Azhari
items.summary: While Iran describes the Houthis as an ally, it publicly denies giving them military direction.
items.body:
The lightning [USN:L6N45203X TEXT:"Houthi advance"] down Yemen's Red Sea coast this week came with direct guidance from Iran's Revolutionary Guards seeking to open a new front in Iran's war with the U.S., according to Yemeni government, Iranian and regional sources.
By seizing the southwestern port city of Mocha, [USN:L6N4500DZ TEXT:"the Houthis"] have strengthened their chokehold on the [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb"] Strait, a key waterway whose disruption further constricts global energy supplies after Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
Six months into the wider regional conflict between the Houthis' Iranian allies and the United States, the group now looks focused on consolidating that [USN:L1N452044 TEXT:"grip on the strait"] even as opposing government forces backed by Saudi Arabia focus on an offensive in the north.
Iran told the Houthis last week to escalate their attacks on Saudi Arabia, a close U.S. ally, and promised more funding, weapons and senior officers to help them do so, two Iranian sources said.
While Iran describes the Houthis as an ally, it publicly denies giving them military direction, saying they are "not a proxy".
Several senior Revolutionary Guards commanders had already travelled to Yemen to oversee and command Houthi attacks directed against Saudi Arabia after weeks of discussions over military strategy, a regional diplomat briefed by Tehran said.
A third Iranian source, an official, said Iran had held several meetings with allies including the Houthis and that the move on Mocha was a Houthi rather than Iranian decision. However, it had helped Iran by putting upward pressure on oil prices and hurting the United States and Saudi Arabia, the official added.
Inside Yemen, five military sources from the Saudi-backed and internationally recognised government said the Revolutionary Guards had directed the new Houthi campaign along the Red Sea coast, a flat, narrow plain known as the Tihama, starting with a blitz of rocket fire.
Citing communications intercepts and the accounts of captured Houthi prisoners, the Yemeni military sources said they believed the Iranian effort was being directed by Abdolreza Shahlaei, a top Revolutionary Guards commander.
Iranian sources were not immediately able to confirm that, though they had previously described Shahlaei, who is in the Guards' specialist Qods Force unit, as having spent time in Yemen in recent years.
The Guards were still able to move weapons and personnel in and out of Yemen despite an aerial and maritime blockade of Houthi areas, the Iranian sources said without elaborating on how they did so.
"If we look at their offensive on the west coast, it's not something prepared just last week or last month," said Ahmed Nagi, Yemen analyst at International Crisis Group, describing the seizure of Mocha as a significant milestone in the war.
"The evolution of the Houthis was basically because of the new weapons they gained, either through the Iranians directly or through the different smuggling networks that they are counting on," Nagi said, pointing specifically at their use of drones in the latest offensive.
UNCERTAIN MILITARY SITUATION As the Houthis began an advance towards Mocha last week, Yemen's government requested more air support and other help from the Saudis, two more Yemeni officials said.
It was seeking a Saudi air campaign against Houthi targets in the Houthi heartland including Sanaa and key strategic assets such as oil depots, they said.
However, the kingdom stuck to providing logistical, armament and intelligence support with only limited air strikes that were focused on northern battlefronts in Jawf and Marib provinces, areas the government regarded as less important.
The officials' own assessment was that Riyadh was anxious to avoid a major escalation with the Houthis for fear of provoking heavier drone strikes on Saudi territory.
Saudi officials did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment on Riyadh's military focus on the northern front rather than the Red Sea coast and other big Houthi targets.
The overall military situation in Yemen is hard to gauge after a years-long pause in major warfare since a ceasefire was agreed in 2022. Both Iran and Saudi Arabia have invested in forces they back there. But the pro-government coalition has suffered from [USN:L6N3Y90RR TEXT:"internal splits"].
Although previous rounds of warfare in the Tihama had produced sudden advances and retreats, it remains unclear if Saudi-backed forces can easily dislodge the Houthis this time, Nagi said.
"Maybe we can see some advances from the government if they get the necessary support from the Saudis. But that could be a bit difficult this time," he said.

items.title: マイクロソフト、学校でのAI利用継続目指す－教員組合とルール整備
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国で学校の新学期が始まる中、教室へのAI浸透に保護者や教員が反発を強めている。全米最大の学区であるニューヨーク市は先週、小中学生によるAIツールの利用を禁止。ロサンゼルス学区もその直後に追随し、より広範な制限を導入した。全面禁止ではない中間的な対応を模索する学区にとっては、米マイクロソフトが今週結んだ協定が、一定のルールを示すものとなりそうだ。

マイクロソフトは9日、米国教員連盟（AFT）との協定を発表し、学校でのAI利用を巡る10の基本原則を順守すると約束した。原則には保護者への明確な情報提供、データ収集の最小化、生徒のデータをAIモデルの学習に使用することの禁止などが含まれる。安全・セキュリティー上の限定的な目的では例外を認めるという。幼稚園から高校までの教員を代表するAFTはこの協定について、同種のものとして最も包括的だと評価。11月1日から、マイクロソフトと契約する全ての学校に自動的に適用されると説明した。

AFTとマイクロソフトが締結した協定は、「生徒は商品ではない。教員はベータテスターではない。そして学校はデータ収集や実験の場ではない」と明記。「AIツールを教室に導入すれば、非常に大きな可能性と同時に、それに匹敵する大きな責任も伴う。この協定は、その責任を果たす上で極めて高い基準を定めるものだ」としている。

AFTとこうした協定を結ぶ初の企業となったマイクロソフトは、学校へのAI導入の進め方を巡ってここ数週間批判を浴びているグーグルとの違いを鮮明にした。米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは最近、教師が課題の配布に広く利用するプラットフォーム「Google Classroom（グーグル・クラスルーム）」で、チャットボット「Gemini（ジェミニ）」の提供を拡大し、多くの学校が不意を突かれたと、教育専門メディアのエデュケーション・ウィークは報じた。

教育テクノロジー新興企業Newselaの共同創業者ダン・コーガン・ドリュー氏は、ポッドキャスト「AI in the Classroom — Daily」で、グーグルのこうした動きに加え、米アンソロピックが最近「Claude for Teachers」を投入したことが、学校でのAI利用に対する反発をあおっているようだと指摘した。一部の学区は「何が起きるか分からない以上、先手を打って禁止しなければならない」との判断に傾いているという。

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国とイランの戦争は長期化の様相を強めている。戦闘が低強度にとどまったとしても、早期の停戦実現や、中東からのエネルギー供給が正常化する兆しはほぼ全く見られない。

ホルムズ海峡の通航量減少を受けて、代替ルートとして重要性を増している紅海では、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が港湾都市モカを制圧したとの情報があり、中東情勢がさらに不安定化する恐れが出ている。

イラン指導部は、今回の戦争を国家の存亡に関わる脅威とみなしており、経済的な痛みが増しても戦闘を続ける決意だと、ブルームバーグはイラン政府高官の話として報じた。イランはミサイル能力を再構築しており、米国側が攻撃を激化させれば、米国や湾岸諸国の関連施設に対する攻撃を拡大する構えだという。

一方、米紙ウォールストリート・ジャーナル（WSJ）によると、バンス副大統領やルビオ国務長官を含む政権高官がトランプ大統領に対し、イラン戦争は同氏の任期が終わる2029年1月まで続く可能性があると伝えた。

戦況はこう着状態に入りつつある。ホルムズ海峡の支配やイランの核開発計画など、重要な争点は依然として解決していない。

トランプ氏は、戦争の目的はイランによる核兵器開発を阻止することだと繰り返し主張しているが、イランが保有する兵器級に近い濃縮ウランの状況や所在は分かっていない。イスラエルと米国がイラン各地の大規模な核施設を攻撃した2025年6月以降、国際原子力機関（IAEA）は確認できていないとしている。

IAEAは10日、イランのピックアックス山で建設活動を確認したと発表した。同施設は厳重に防護され、核関連活動が行われている疑いがある。トランプ氏はここ数日で2度言及し、新たな攻撃対象となる可能性を警告している。

長期化の見通しが強まっている現在の状況は、11月3日の中間選挙後に戦争は「直ちに」終わると言い放ったトランプ氏の発言とは相容れない。中間選挙では、イラン戦争とそれに伴うエネルギー価格の上昇が大きな影を落としている。

items.title: What's happened to al Qaeda in the 25 years since 9/11?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: In the 25 years since al Qaeda militants hijacked passenger jets and flew them into New York's World Trade Center towers and the Pentagon, the group founded by Osama bin Laden has spawned affiliates and inspired attacks around the world.
items.body:
In the 25 years since al Qaeda militants hijacked passenger jets and flew them into New York's World Trade Center towers and the Pentagon, the group founded by Osama bin Laden has spawned affiliates and inspired attacks around the world.
While it has suffered setbacks, notably bin Laden's killing in 2011 by U.S. forces and the emergence of Islamic State as a rival, experts say al Qaeda still serves as a source of support and inspiration for militants in many regions, particularly in Africa.
WHAT IS AL QAEDA? Al Qaeda emerged as a transnational jihadist network in the late 1980s under the leadership of bin Laden, a wealthy Saudi-born militant who had helped recruit and funnel support to Arab volunteers fighting the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan after 1979 and fought there himself.
Al Qaeda became a magnet for militants who aspired to establish hardline Islamist rule and who shared common hostility to the United States, Israel and U.S.-allied governments in the region.
Bin Laden was stripped of his Saudi citizenship in 1994 and expelled from Sudan in 1996, taking sanctuary in Afghanistan.
He began organising attacks on U.S. interests long before arriving in Afghanistan. The first recognized by the United States was a 1992 al Qaeda bombing of two hotels in Yemen intended to kill Somalia-bound U.S. troops who had already left or were staying elsewhere.
In Afghanistan, he supported training camps and established an elite brigade of foreign fighters.
In 1996, he declared jihad against U.S. forces he described as occupying Saudi Arabia.
This was followed in 1998 by the announcement of a "World Islamic Front" for jihad against "Jews and Crusaders", and a declaration that it was a duty for Muslims to kill Americans and their allies, whether civilian or military.
Later that year, al Qaeda truck bombings against the U.S. embassies in Kenya and Tanzania killed 224 people.
The September 11 attacks were carried out by 19 hijackers, 15 of them from Saudi Arabia. They hijacked four jets, the fourth of which crashed in a field in Pennsylvania after passengers stormed the cockpit. The attacks killed nearly 3,000 people.
WHAT HAPPENED TO AL QAEDA'S LEADERS AFTER 9/11? The United States invaded Afghanistan in October 2001, toppling the Taliban and driving al Qaeda from its base of operations.
Anti-Taliban forces overran al Qaeda's base in the Tora Bora mountains in December 2001, but bin Laden evaded capture for a decade, periodically releasing messages until U.S. special forces killed him in a raid on his compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, in 2011.
The self-professed mastermind of September 11, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, was captured in Pakistan in 2003. In 2007, Mohammed said he planned the attack "from A to Z", according to a transcript of a military hearing released by the Pentagon.
A judge [USN:L1N44O02T TEXT:"recently ordered Mohammed"], who is held in Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, and three co-defendants to stand trial before a military tribunal in June 2028, following two decades of legal deadlock.
Bin Laden's successor, Ayman al-Zawahri, was killed by a U.S. drone strike in Kabul in 2022.
Egyptian militant [USN:L4N2ZG1XM TEXT:"Seif al-Adel"] is believed to be al Qaeda's de facto leader today.
HOW DID ITS INFLUENCE SPREAD AFTER 9/11? While al Qaeda's leaders scattered, militants linked to al Qaeda or inspired by its ideology carried out numerous attacks.
The deadliest included a 2002 attack on a nightclub district in Bali that killed 202 people, bombings that killed more than 190 people on trains in Madrid in 2004, and suicide bombings that killed 52 people on London underground trains and a bus in 2005.
Al Qaeda affiliates sprang up in the Middle East and beyond. One of the most powerful was in Iraq, where al Qaeda fought U.S.-led forces following the 2003 invasion.
A branch emerged in North Africa in 2007 and another in the Arabian Peninsula in 2009. After 2011, al Qaeda's Nusra Front became a force in Syria's civil war.
In Africa, al Qaeda affiliates include Al Shabaab in Somalia and Jama'at Nusrat al‑Islam wal‑Muslimin (JNIM) in the Sahel region. Al Qaeda also has ties to Tehrik-e Taliban Pakistan (TTP), also known as Pakistani Taliban, which is waging an insurgency against Islamabad.
Antonio Giustozzi, a senior research fellow at the RUSI think-tank in London, said that while al Qaeda suffered losses and dislocation after the invasion of Afghanistan, its profile rose and it expanded massively in the years that followed. Its influence peaked around 2013 before its Iraqi branch broke away to form Islamic State, he said.
HOW WAS AL QAEDA AFFECTED BY THE RISE OF ISLAMIC STATE? Islamic State founder Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi split from al Qaeda and declared a "caliphate" across large parts of Syria and Iraq in 2014, sparking conflict with the Nusra Front.
Though Islamic State was eventually beaten out of its territory in Syria and Iraq, in a reversal for jihadism, its rivalry with al Qaeda continues, particularly in West Africa where affiliates of the two groups regularly clash as they compete for territory and influence.
Another blow came in 2016 when the Nusra Front broke away. Its leader [USN:L8N3RL1DT TEXT:"Ahmed al-Sharaa"], then known by his nom de guerre Abu Mohammed al-Golani, went on to topple Bashar al-Assad in 2024. He became Syrian president and made Damascus a Western ally.
WHERE IS AL QAEDA MOST ACTIVE TODAY? Somalia and West Africa's [USN:L8N41E0D9 TEXT:"Sahel region"] are the main theatres in Africa where al Qaeda-aligned groups are expanding their influence and [USN:L8N42D139 TEXT:"governing across"] swathes of territory.
TTP has expanded its insurgency in northwestern Pakistan. It has received ideological guidance, training and support from al Qaeda, according to a U.N. report published last month.
Pakistan says the TTP leadership and many of its fighters are based in Afghanistan, where the Taliban returned to power in 2021 after the U.S. withdrew.
In February, another U.N. report said al Qaeda "continued to enjoy the patronage of the de facto authorities" in Afghanistan — a reference to the Taliban government — and that its "appetite for external operations" remained "undiminished".
Kabul denies that al Qaeda operates in Afghanistan, or that it allows militant attacks on Pakistan from its territory.
Giustozzi said that while al Qaeda was past its peak "they're still remarkably influential".
It had evolved to be less dependent on specific individuals, relying instead on a cadre of low-profile operatives who are "much more difficult to target and identify", he said.

items.title: Newfoundland and Labrador to lead economic growth in 2026, Ontario to lag: report
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: A new report says Newfoundland and Labrador is expected to lead the country’s economic growth, driven by higher crude prices and offshore oil projects.
items.body: OTTAWA — A new report says Newfoundland and Labrador is expected to lead the country’s economic growth for a second year in a row, driven by higher crude prices and offshore oil projects. Signal49 Research, previously the Conference Board of Canada, says the province’s economy will expand 3.7 per cent in 2026, though longer-term growth will be constrained by demographic pressures. The research think tank predicts Ontario will post the weakest growth of all Canadian provinces this year with the economy expanding just 0.2 per cent. The report says Ontario and Quebec have been hit hardest by U.S. tariffs because of their heavy manufacturing sectors. It says overall economic conditions across Canada are expected to improve in the latter half of the year as hiring activity increases and businesses become more confident in their investment plans. Richard Forbes, lead economist at Signal49 Research, says the conflict in the Middle East, demographic pressures and ongoing tariff uncertainty have had reverberating impacts across the country but have been felt unevenly. “The increased energy prices have had benefits for some provinces, while the tariffs have been hardest on Ontario and Quebec due to the exposure in the manufacturing sector,” he said in a news release. --- Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 10, 2026.

items.title: Canada needs up to 4.69 million new homes by 2036, but construction could slow: CMHC
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corp. said between 417,000 and 469,000 new housing units are needed per year across ownership and rental markets.
items.body: The federal housing agency says Canada narrowly chipped away at its supply gap over the past year, but the country still needs up to nearly 4.7 million new homes over the next decade to restore pre-pandemic affordability by 2036. Canada Mortgage and Housing Corp. released its latest supply gap estimate report, which said between 417,000 and 469,000 new housing units are needed per year across the ownership and rental markets over the next decade to reach affordability targets. That’s down slightly from its last estimate in July 2025, when CMHC said the pace of home construction would need to roughly double to between 430,000 and 480,000 new units annually over the coming decade. But the agency says recent affordability gains are at risk as new home construction is instead expected to slow, especially in the home ownership market. CMHC deputy chief economist Aled ab Iorwerth says housing costs have come down overall, citing slower population growth, but the “key risk now is Canada underbuilds during this softer market and finds itself further short of housing when demand strengthens again.” Since the agency’s previous estimates, it says the housing supply gap has narrowed in Toronto, remained stable in Vancouver, and grown larger in Montreal and Ottawa. Meanwhile, record housing construction in Calgary has narrowed its housing supply gap “significantly,” while Edmonton remains the only large market in Canada without a housing supply gap. --- Sammy Hudes, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 10, 2026.

items.title: ビットコイン4日続落、8万ドルを大きく割り込む－不安定な環境が重し
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 仮想通貨（暗号資産）ビットコインは10日に4日続落し、8万ドルの大台を大きく割り込んで推移している。リスク資産を巡る不安定な市場環境が新たな重しとなっている。

中東情勢の緊張が再燃し、投資家のリスクテーク意欲が減退した。北海ブレント先物は1バレル＝105ドルを上回ったほか、株式と債券は下落。8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）は、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が利上げをするとの観測を大きく変える内容ではなかった。

ビットコインはニューヨーク時間の朝方に一時、前日比2.1%安の7万6663.54ドルを付けた。2月上旬以降、おおむね6万－8万ドルのレンジで推移している。昨年10月には過去最高値の12万6000ドル台を付けた。

このところの続落でも、ビットコインは引き続き最近の取引レンジ内で推移しており、新たな下落局面に入ったことを示唆しているわけではない。

しかし、8月に相場が大きく回復した後、8万ドル台になかなか定着できないでいることは、上昇を足掛かりに一段高となるのが難しくなっている状況を浮き彫りにする。

8月の米PPIは総合が前月比0.4%上昇と、5月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前年同月比では5.4%上昇だった。

items.title: What comes next in Italy's banking deal frenzy
items.author: Valentina Za, Gianluca Semeraro
items.creator: Valentina Za, Gianluca Semeraro
items.summary: The latest twist in Italy's banking takeover saga has pitted market leader Intesa Sanpaolo against the biggest winner of the shakeup so far, Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS).
items.body:
The latest twist in Italy's banking takeover saga has pitted market leader Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) against the biggest winner of the shakeup so far, Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) (MPS).
With a less concentrated banking sector than France or Spain, Italy has seen a wave of bids and counterbids since late 2024 as lenders jockey for position amid a revival in dealmaking fuelled by stronger balance sheets and excess capital.
The deal frenzy has baffled even seasoned observers, with MPS now pursuing a two-pronged defence strategy to try to fend off Intesa's takeover approach. Intesa on Thursday [USN:L8N4520OF TEXT:"secured shareholder"] approval for the share financing of its plan.
Here's where things stand, and what might happen next.
WHAT'S THE LATEST? The first merger wave has reshaped Italy's second-tier banking sector, which sits below industry giants Intesa and UniCredit (CRDI.MI) .
A long-running political ambition to create a third major group has helped transform MPS, which was rescued by Rome in 2017 and reprivatised in 2023-2024, into an unlikely acquirer.
Last year, MPS bought bigger rival Mediobanca and, through that deal, became the leading shareholder in Generali (GASI.MI) , Italy's biggest insurer, which both Intesa and UniCredit covet.
After UniCredit [USN:L8N42Q05T TEXT:"built a 9% stake in Generali"] last year, Intesa [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"launched"] its €35 billion ($41 billion) cash-and-shares bid for MPS in June. The deal would give Intesa roughly 13% of Generali, control of Mediobanca and half of MPS's branch network.
Critical of Intesa's plan to break up its retail network, MPS initially explored a merger proposed by mid-sized peer Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) [USN:L1N42F03F TEXT:"hours before"] Intesa unveiled its offer.
When [USN:L8N4422XY TEXT:"talks with BPM broke down"] last month, MPS responded with all-share bids for both BPM and wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) .
MPS's Generali stake is now key to its [USN:L1N44H0NA TEXT:"defence strategy"].
The bank plans to use part of that holding to reward shareholders, who would receive €3 billion in cash as part of the mainly share-based offer from Intesa.
Generali CEO Philippe Donnet has also emerged as an important ally for MPS boss Luigi Lovaglio, with [USN:L8N44O0FV TEXT:"the insurer now open"] to exploring commercial deals with the Tuscan bank.
Generali, which competes with Intesa in life insurance, owns 50.2% of Banca Generali and could choose to tender its stake.
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? MPS shareholders are due to vote on the defence plan on October 29.
Thursday's approval of Intesa's financing plans was widely expected. The real uncertainty now centres on the October vote.
Investors remain cautious about MPS' €37 billion twin bids for BPM and Banca Generali, with shares in both targets trading below the offer values.
Still, several people close to Intesa told Reuters the scheme had significantly complicated its takeover plans by creating uncertainty and confusing investors.
WHAT'S THE COMPLICATION? Intesa is awaiting European Central Bank and antitrust approvals for its bid, with the tender offer expected to begin only after MPS shareholders vote on its defence plan.
MPS investors could approve its twin bids and still choose to tender their shares into Intesa's offer.
Intesa is counting on completing its offer by the end of December, before MPS has a chance to launch its own bids.
COULD UNICREDIT MAKE A MOVE? UniCredit's 9% Generali stake has given it sway in the Intesa-MPS battle.
Now that its two-year pursuit of Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) has left it with de facto control of the German lender, UniCredit could refocus on Italy, where it has so far failed to make a mark in the consolidation wave, bankers said.
UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel has said he may forego domestic acquisitions rather than overpay.
Bankers don't expect Orcel to disrupt Intesa's plans directly, and instead view Banco BPM and Banca Generali as potential targets for UniCredit.
WHAT'S THE GOVERNMENT'S STANCE? The government has maintained [USN:L8N44W0N8 TEXT:"a neutral position"] in the latest banking tussle and is not expected to participate in the October vote with its remaining 4.9% stake in MPS.
($1 = 0.8603 euros)

items.title: 米中古住宅販売、年率で400万戸割れ－購入希望者は金利低下待ち
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 8月の米中古住宅販売件数は年率換算で400万戸を割り込み、2025年6月以来の低い数字となった。住宅購入を検討する人々が、住宅ローン金利の低下を待っていることが背景にある。

販売件数の落ち込みは、好転のきっかけを切実に必要としている住宅市場の状況を映している。住宅価格の伸びは、前年比上昇率が2桁に達していたパンデミック期から鈍化したものの、住宅取得能力を巡る懸念は引き続き買い手にとって強い向かい風となっている。

中古住宅の販売価格中央値は前年同月比1.6%上昇して42万9100ドルとなり、2023年半ばからの上昇基調は継続した。

現在の住宅ローン金利は1年余りで最も高い水準にあり、これも住み替えをためらわせる要因となっている。数年前に現在の半分未満の金利でローンを借り換えた人々は、特に慎重になっている。アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントが最近発表したリポートによると、全米の住宅ローン残高のうち、金利が6%を上回るものは4分の1に満たない。

NARのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「住宅ローン金利と住宅販売は逆方向に動くため、高い住宅ローン金利によって住宅購入活動が小幅に落ち込んだとしても驚きではない」と発表資料で述べた。

それでも、住宅ローン金利の上昇で買い手が「完全に撤退しているわけではない」と、ユン氏は記者との電話会見で述べ、雇用と賃金の増加が需要を支えていると指摘した。ただ、住宅ローン金利は近く7%に達する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

市場にとって明るい兆しの一つは、売り出し中の住宅が増加したことだ。NARのリポートによると、8月の市場に供給されている中古住宅は前年同月比5.9%増の162万戸となり、2019年11月以来の高水準に達した。

現在の販売ペースでは、住宅供給は4.9カ月分に相当し、10年余りで最多となる。

NARがまとめた「住宅アフォーダビリティー指数」も、住宅取得能力の改善を示した。この指数は、一般的な世帯の所得が販売価格中央値の住宅を購入するための住宅ローン審査基準を満たしているかを示す。8月の同指数は前年同月比3.5%上昇したものの、歴史的に低い水準にとどまっている。

items.title: A generation processes the September 11 attacks as history, not memory
items.author: Jenna Zucker, Ben Kellerman
items.creator: Jenna Zucker, Ben Kellerman
items.summary: From New York to New Zealand, people too young to remember 9/11 sent us their stories. They described how they first learned about the attacks and how the events of that day continue to influence the way they see the United States and the world.
items.body:
Ava Kathleen Schmoelzer, 7, makes a rubbing of her late aunt's name, Kathleen Moran, at the World Trade Center memorial in New York, September 11, 2012. REUTERS/Justin Lane

Twenty-five years after the September 11, 2001, attacks, an entire generation has grown up with no memory of that day.
For some, parents or teachers first explained 9/11 — a day that left nearly 3,000 people dead. Others came to understand it through school, the internet or the wars and political upheaval that followed.
We asked people who were too young to remember the attacks to tell us what 9/11 means to them and how an event they didn't witness has shaped the world they grew up in. Here is what they told us.

TYLER YEZERMANSKI , New Haven, Connecticut, born in 2001
Born six months before 9/11, Yezermanski first learned about the attacks in first grade. He later served in Afghanistan in 2021 during the final months of a war that had stretched across nearly his entire life — an experience that helped shape how he thinks about the day of the attacks, its legacy and the way it is still interpreted today.
EMANI LABREW , New York City, born in 2001
Labrew remembers learning about 9/11 after seeing a YouTube video as a child and her mother explaining what happened that day. Born and raised in New York City, she says it ingrained a feeling that she could “pretty much expect anything to happen” there — but above all else, she feels empathetic toward her city and the people who saw the attacks firsthand.
UTKARSH BHATNAGAR , Hamburg, Germany, born in 2000
Bhatnagar says he understands 9/11 as the moment everything changed in terms of security and aviation. While growing up in New Delhi, India, he did not seek out much information about the attacks, but he was later shaken by the images he saw in documentaries, which he credits for giving him a fuller picture of what happened. He believes the way the U.S. handled the aftermath is the reason "certain things are perceived the way they are now."
JACK JOHNSON , Chicago, Illinois, born in 2001
Two months old when 9/11 happened, Johnson sees it as the defining event of the 21st century in the United States, shaping the country’s politics, polarization, fear and sense of national disunity long after the attacks themselves. “I think that every single political trend in the United States in the 21st century can be traced back to that day,” Johnson said.
A child places a candle during a memorial service in London on the anniversary of the 9/11 attack, in Britain, September 11, 2021. REUTERS/May James PAIGE McCUSKER , Altoona, Pennsylvania, born in 2003
With no personal memory of 9/11, McCusker says the attacks were simply something that was always part of growing up in the United States. Her understanding deepened in fourth grade, when a teacher showed the class footage from the attacks.
One set of images still sticks out: Airports in older films and TV shows like “Gilmore Girls” look noticeably different.
AVERY TURNER , Louisville, Kentucky, born in 2007
Growing up after 9/11 means inheriting an America permanently changed by the attacks, Turner says. With the wars that followed, that includes America's image to the rest of the world, a legacy that he does not believe his generation will ever escape.
JASMINE CORLISS , Napier, New Zealand, born in 1995
Growing up in New Zealand, Corliss remembers hearing about 9/11 in bits and pieces until learning about it in more depth in around 2009, when she went to high school. She recalls her father telling her that after the attacks happened, he was called into his job to put fences around local water sources in her city in New Zealand — reinforcing how far the impact was felt.
A child is carried during a ceremony marking the 14th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks, at the World Trade Center memorial in New York, September 11, 2015. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

items.title: 【米国市況】S&P500が4日続落、原油高で利回り上昇－円はPPI後に下落
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 10日の米金融市場では、株式と国債が下落。原油価格が再び上昇し、株式と国債に売りが広がった。エネルギーコスト上昇による物価圧力が強まる中、8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）統計を受け、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が近く利上げに踏み切るとの観測が一段と強まった。円はPPI発表後に1ドル＝154円67銭まで下げた。

北海ブレント原油が1バレル＝108ドルを超え、米国債利回りは数年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。短期金融市場では連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）が来週の会合で利上げに踏み切る確率が70%に上昇し、10月までの利上げを完全に織り込んだ。米財務省による国債買い戻しが51億9000万ドルと、事前に示していた上限額を下回ったことも相場を圧迫した。S&P500種株価指数は4営業日続落し、6月以降で長期の連続安となった。

PPI統計は、エネルギー価格の上昇に伴い、インフレ圧力が再び高まっていることを示した。11日には消費者物価指数（CPI）が発表される。CPI統計では、ガソリン価格の上昇で総合指数が押し上げられる一方、コアインフレは比較的穏やかな伸びにとどまると予想されている。

FRB当局者の一部は、15－16日のFOMC会合での金利判断は、今週発表される一連の統計の内容次第になる可能性があると示唆している。

ベルウェザー・ウェルスのクラーク・ベリン氏は「インフレは依然として問題だ」と指摘。「金利を動かしても原油高を抑えることはできないが、インフレ圧力に対応するのがFRBの役割だ」と述べた。

LPLファイナンシャルのジェフリー・ローチ氏は、イランとの戦争が長引くにつれ、インフレ圧力がますます根強くなっていると指摘。この状況が続けば、FOMCが来週の会合で利上げに踏み切る可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

エバコアのクリシュナ・グハ氏は「現時点では、利上げがほぼ確実な状況にはまだ程遠いと考えている」と述べた。「とはいえ、FRBが新たな供給ショックを再び受け入れる余地はなくなりつつある可能性がある」と指摘した。グハ氏によると、エバコアは金利維持の予想を見直しており、CPIの発表後に予想を更新する。

items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 10日午前の米金融市場では、株式と国債が下落。原油価格が再び上昇し、株式と国債に売りが広がっている。8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）統計を受け、エネルギーコスト上昇による物価圧力が強まる中、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が近く利上げに踏み切るとの観測が一段と強まった。

北海ブレント原油は1バレル＝105ドルを上回った。サウジアラビアが石油輸出国機構（OPEC）に報告したところによると、米国とイランの戦闘で輸出ルートが圧迫される中、同国の生産量は8月に再び急減した。S&P500種株価指数は4営業日続落で始まった。米国債は年限を問わず下落し、30年債利回りは2007年以来の高水準付近となった。短期金融市場では、来週の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）での利上げの確率が70%に上昇し、10月までの利上げを完全に織り込んだ。

原油価格とともに米国債利回りが急上昇する中、ドル指数は上げ幅を拡大した。円は対ドルで4日ぶりに反落。PPI発表後に1ドル＝154円67銭まで下げ、その後は154円台前半まで下げ渋っている。

items.title: 米PPIは5月以来の大幅上昇、エネルギー高を反映－9月利上げ後押しか
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 8月の米生産者物価指数（PPI）統計は、エネルギー価格の上昇に伴い、インフレ圧力が再び高まっていることを示した。来週の米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）での利上げ決定を後押しする材料となる可能性がある。

総合指数は前月比0.4%上昇と、5月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。

PPIに続き、11日には8月の米消費者物価指数（CPI）が公表される。CPI統計では、ガソリン価格の上昇で総合指数が押し上げられる一方、食品とエネルギー価格を除くコア指数は比較的穏やかな伸びにとどまると予想されている。

FRB当局者の一部は、9月15－16両日に開催されるFOMCの政策判断について、今週発表されるインフレ統計の内容が左右する可能性があると示唆している。

ウォーシュFRB議長は先月の講演で、基調的なインフレ率が明確に改善しているとの確信を政策当局者が持てないのであれば、FRBには「やるべき仕事がある」と述べた。

PPI統計では、エネルギー価格と輸送・倉庫関連コストが、2カ月連続で低下した後、8月に急上昇した。米国とイランの戦闘が続く中で原油価格は再び上昇しており、物価の先行きはさらに見通しにくくなりそうだ。

PPIの発表後、米利上げの織り込みが進み、米国株は下げて開始。米国債利回りは上昇している。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの北米担当チーフエコノミスト、スティーブン・ブラウン氏は、「PPIは総じてなお比較的強めで、FRBは今月利上げに踏み切らないとしても、年内には利上げをする可能性が高い」と指摘した。

PPI統計では、航空運賃や病院の入院、外来診療価格が8月に大幅上昇した。法務サービスも1.7％上昇し、データがさかのぼれる2009年以降で最大の伸びとなった。これらはFRBが特に注目する項目で、FRBが重視するインフレ指標である個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数の算出に反映される。

米商務省経済分析局（BEA）は30日に、8月のPCE価格指数を個人所得・支出データとともに発表する予定。BEAは同月分から、法務サービスやコンピューターソフトウエア、投資助言など一部項目の価格測定方法を変更する。エコノミストの間では、今回の変更によりPCE価格指数が従来より低く出るとの見方が多い。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: MOSCOW: Bone fragments from the sword hand of a medieval Russian prince who won a famous victory over the Mongols have been sent to the front in Ukraine to raise army morale in the Russian Orthodox Church's latest show of support for

Russia sends bones of medieval warrior prince to Ukraine front to boost morale

Russian President Vladimir Putin stands by the relics of the Holy Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy, which were discovered in the course of restoration works, during a service at the Archangel Cathedral of the Kremlin in Moscow, Russia, on Aug 20, 2026. (Photo: Sputnik/Vyacheslav Prokofyev/Pool via REUTER)

FAST

MOSCOW: Bone fragments from the sword hand of a medieval Russian prince who won a famous victory over the Mongols have been sent to the front in Ukraine to raise army morale in the Russian Orthodox Church's latest show of support for President Vladimir Putin's war .
The sarcophagus of Grand Prince Dmitry Donskoy, who died in 1389 and is revered by Russian nationalists for defeating the Mongol Golden Horde at the 1380 Battle of Kulikovo, was uncovered this summer during restoration work at Moscow's Cathedral of the Archangel inside the Kremlin.
Putin personally inspected what experts said were the prince's well-preserved remains in August, hailing them as "an absolutely unique and marvellous discovery" which reinforced the foundations of Russian history.
The Russian Orthodox Church, which has backed Putin throughout the conflict, said it had dispatched a fragment of Donskoy's right hand to Donetsk, one of four Ukrainian regions Putin said he had incorporated into Russia in 2022, a move Kyiv rejected as an illegal land grab.

Referring to Donskoy as "the holy commander," the Moscow Patriarchate of the Russian Orthodox Church said part of his remains had been sent to the front to stand invisibly shoulder-to-shoulder with Russian troops.
"A fragment of the Grand Prince's right hand - the very same right hand with which he wielded his sword on Kulikovo Field - has been sent to the front to strengthen the soldiers' spirits," it said in a statement.
The relic, held in a small ornate casket beneath toughened glass, will be shown to Russian combat units along the more than 1,000km front line, it said.
Donskoy, whose name was given to a Soviet tank column funded by the church in World War II, was declared a saint by the Russian Orthodox Church in 1988.
PATRIOTIC PUSH The carefully choreographed effort to use his remains in a public relations exercise to boost patriotism and morale comes ahead of a parliamentary election later this month.
Russian military and church officials have presented the discovery as a fortuitous find that could help Russian forces prevail in Ukraine, now in the fifth year of a grinding war.
The tour also comes as Russian forces seek full control of the Donetsk region in eastern Ukraine and as diplomatic efforts to end the war have yet to yield a breakthrough .
Donskoy's relics were carried through the streets of Moscow at the weekend in a huge Orthodox procession.
At a ceremony at a World War II memorial in Donetsk on Tuesday, Sergei Kiriyenko, Putin's first deputy Kremlin chief of staff, joined military commanders and the Russian-installed regional head in kissing the relic and making the sign of the cross as a priest read a prayer.

A Russian Army officer leans to a case with relics of a medieval Russian prince Dmitry Donskoy during a citywide procession marking the Feast of the Moscow Saints in Moscow, Russia, on Sep 6, 2026. (Photo: Yaroslav Chingaev/Moscow News Agency/Handout via REUTERS)

"Both our military personnel and the people who live in Donbas need strengthening from above, need God's help and the blessing of our saints," Metropolitan Vladimir of Donetsk and Mariupol, a senior Moscow-appointed cleric, said. Donbas is a broader area incorporating Donetsk and neighbouring Luhansk which Russia controls almost in its entirety.
Elsewhere, commanders have presented Donskoy's remains as evidence that God is on Russia's side.
The Defence Ministry on Wednesday released footage of troops in the Sverdlovsk region attending a church service carrying icons and Orthodox flags, alongside an interview with a commander who said the relics would support Russia's victory.
Critics, however, have accused the Church of breaking with religious protocol to please the Kremlin. They have also questioned why Donskoy's remains, whose location was broadly known for decades, were recovered and venerated only now, 38 years after he was declared a saint.
"By the fifth year of war, the Church leadership in Moscow began to wonder what else it could do to show its support for what Russia terms its 'special military operation'," Alexander Zanemonets, an Orthodox priest and historian based outside Russia, wrote in a note for the Carnegie Russia Eurasia Center whose director Russia has designated a "foreign agent."
"It had already sent priests to the front lines, instituted mandatory prayers for Russian victory in every church, and flown icons over cities. A state embroiled in war will try to compel all institutions, including religious ones, to participate in it."

Source: Reuters/ec

NEW DELHI: India will host the BRICS Leaders' Summit this weekend, seeking to lift the bloc's global profile even as the US-led war on Iran splits its membership, with Tehran and Abu Dhabi on opposing sides of the conflict.
The Sep 12-13 summit in New Delhi comes more than six months after the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran, a BRICS member since 2024. The conflict has led to a virtual shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's key choke points in the oil trade, pushing crude prices to over US$100 a barrel.
BRICS member UAE, after being hit by Iranian missiles since the war began, suspended all trade and financial transactions with Iran in August .
Foreign policy experts said the key test for the bloc will be finding language on the Middle East crisis that both Abu Dhabi and Tehran can accept, clearing the way for a joint declaration.

Such a joint statement was unlikely to influence the current geopolitical landscape, but will demonstrate, for instance, that a forum of emerging countries could be united against economically debilitating policies like Western sanctions, they said.
Chinese President Xi Jinping will attend in his first visit to India in seven years , underscoring the importance Beijing attaches to BRICS and placing China alongside host India at the centre of efforts to hold the expanded bloc together.
Russian President Vladimir Putin, Iran's Masoud Pezeshkian, South Africa's Cyril Ramaphosa, Egypt's Abdel Fattah al-Sisi and Indonesia's Prabowo Subianto are also due, along with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.
The UAE is expected to be represented by Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.
IRAN WAR HAS NEGATIVE IMPACT ON BLOC Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Tuesday that the differences between the UAE and Iran had a "negative impact" and get in the way of "drafting" a joint declaration, but hoped the leaders will be able to find a phrasing that will be acceptable to both countries.
Originally comprising Brazil, Russia, India, China and later South Africa, BRICS has expanded with the addition of Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, the UAE and Indonesia, reflecting its ambition to represent a wider Global South.
Saudi Arabia's role in the grouping remains ambiguous as it has not accepted full membership but participates with lower-level delegations. Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud will attend the Delhi meeting.
"Some of (BRICS') new members, Iran and the UAE, Egypt and Ethiopia are embroiled in tensions and don't agree much. This is bad news for an entity that operates based on consensus," said Michael Kugelman, a senior fellow at the Atlantic Council.
"There is an irony here: BRICS expansion reflects its growing appeal and prominence. But that very expansion, because of the divergent views of the new members, could make the group less effective."
In May, foreign ministers of BRICS nations failed to issue a joint statement after a meeting in New Delhi due to differences between Iran and the UAE.

Related:

Commentary: Is a map war brewing between India and China?

Iran to join BRICS development bank soon, central bank governor says

However, earlier this month, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit offered grounds for optimism because its members found language on the Iran conflict acceptable to countries with differing positions.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Xi, Putin and Pezeshkian, among others, signed a joint declaration condemning the US-Israeli military campaign against Iran and Western sanctions.
Former Indian diplomat Rajiv Bhatia said the joint statement at the SCO summit, which however does not include the UAE, has raised hopes for BRICS to be able to bridge the divide.
"There has been a significant forward movement in Bishkek at the SCO summit," Bhatia said. Despite SCO having members that are pro-US, "they were able to bring out a formulation which was acceptable to all sides".
Experts also said that US President Donald Trump's protectionism and unilateral tariff policies have given reasons for BRICS countries to come together and could lead to two-way or three-way meetings between leaders of the countries.
Later this month, Xi is expected to travel to the US. It was not immediately clear if he would hold talks with Putin in Delhi on the sidelines of the summit, ahead of his meeting with Trump.
KEY BILATERALS Beyond efforts to secure agreement on the Middle East, attention will also focus on potential bilateral meetings between Modi and Xi, and on scheduled talks between Modi and Putin.
A likely Modi-Xi meeting would be their third since ties began improving last year following an agreement to ease military tensions along their disputed Himalayan border .
Xi is expected to hold talks with Modi on the summit’s sidelines, with the two leaders likely to review efforts to stabilise relations and deepen economic engagement.
Peskov said on Tuesday that Putin would hold bilateral talks with Modi on Friday ahead of the summit, with trade and economic cooperation expected to feature prominently on the agenda.
The meeting comes as Russia remains one of India's largest energy suppliers and New Delhi seeks to balance its longstanding strategic partnership with Moscow against pressure from Washington over Russian oil purchases.

Source: Reuters/ec
